title: Social Justice in Kinesiology
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in KNES287.
Recommended: Minimum grade of C- in KNES285.
Restriction: Must be in a major within the SPHL-Kinesiology department; and must have earned a minimum of 90 credits.
Credit only granted for: KNES498M or KNES486.
Formerly: KNES498M.
